_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: oto-core
summary: The temporal vocabulary every OTO ontology rests on, the one class every fact cites (Document), and the one node every graph holds about itself (Graph).

changelog.note: Graph (roadmap A1, A2): the node every graph holds about itself and about the graphs it depends on, with subject, classes, reach and slug; depends_on_graph; CORE4. `oto init` writes the project's own descriptor.

Action is now Tool, MCP's word for the same shape; `was` keeps Action as its former name: old nodes read as Tool, and the old IRI stays in the export, deprecated and equivalent. acts_on and executed_by now have domain Tool.
The sample documents carry their date as as_of, not as an undeclared `date` attribute; an extender that declares attributes on Document composed a sample it could not check.
Ships its competency questions (questions.json): every class, relation and attribute is cited by a question that runs, and the sample answers each one it must.
Declares its namespace: its terms keep one IRI in the RDF export of every project that uses it.
Action, acts_on and executed_by join the core; the status `intended` for a fact asserted as a plan; the policy rule intended-fact-overdue.
Split out of the four shipped ontologies, which now extend it.
